acceptanceCriteria: `tasks-scale gen --tickets 10000` finishes in minutes, with measured per-ticket time roughly constant as the store grows.
The cause of the superlinear slowdown is recorded in a build-log entry.
body: Found in the V1-0913 lane (2026-10-11). `tasks-scale gen --tickets 10000` wrote only 1,869 tickets in about 1.5 hours and slowed as the store grew, so 10k-ticket scale tests (idle CPU, read scale) are impractical.
title: Make tasks-scale gen scale roughly linearly
